description.value: Dine Kanadiyan is an authentic Filipino restaurant that opened in 2024 in New Westminster, occupying the former Union Jack Public House space on Seventh Street. The menu spans ala carte classics, a weekend brunch silog lineup, party tray catering, and a communal 'Boodle Fight' buffet format rooted in traditional Filipino dining culture. Live entertainment rounds out the experience, making it a destination for both casual meals and celebrations.
